Name: ManaMune
Author: Noffletoff
Punchline: Your chest tracks your mana bar.
Description:
Drives the breast bones from how much mana you have left, through Customize+. Full at 100%, smaller as you spend - or the other way round. Your own Customize+ profile is read and carried along, so nothing else you have scaled is lost while it runs.

Requires Customize+. Local only: nobody else sees it.
